title: Multiplication check · show your working
description: Try the first five questions on your own, without a calculator or AI answers. Save your working, even if you are unsure. If you get stuck, explain where and move on; do not keep struggling to finish a timer. The last question is optional. Rory will use the actual work to plan what to practise next.
objectives: Show how you multiply two- and three-digit numbers.
Identify which steps need practice, including place value and carrying.
source: Original starting check requested by Rory on 12 November 2026; not a textbook task, diagnosis or formal grade.
